name: ai-swift
description: Catches Xcode Cloud and TestFlight blockers before upload (XcodeGen pbxproj drift, static build numbers, missing ci_scripts, macOS App Store entitlements/Info.plist, headless-CI keychain test failures, ad-hoc signing entitlement rejections, flaky-UITest release gating), diagnoses ITMS rejection emails and red CI logs, scaffolds Xcode Cloud CI, runs a local verify gate, and reviews Swift 6 strict-concurrency and SwiftUI code
